name: MonarchSectionCard
title: SectionCard
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.material3.Surface with the MonarchCard colors, MonarchSectionHeader, androidx.compose.animation.AnimatedVisibility for the collapsible body, MonarchLoadingState, MonarchEmptyState and MonarchErrorState
summary: A titled card for one section of a screen or dashboard: a header with actions, the body, an optional footer, built-in loading, empty and error states, and an optional collapsible body.
whenToUse: For the sections of a dashboard or a settings screen that load their own data, such as open tickets, usage or a danger zone, so every section shows loading, empty and error the same way.
whenNotToUse: For a plain surface without a title use MonarchCard. For a title above content that is not boxed use MonarchSectionHeader. For a disclosure inside a form use MonarchCollapsible.
api: @Composable public fun MonarchSectionCard(title: String, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, description: String? = null, meta: String? = null, tone: MonarchTone = MonarchTone.Neutral, state: MonarchSectionCardState = MonarchSectionCardState.Ready, busy: Boolean = false, retrying: Boolean = false, flush: Boolean = false, expanded: Boolean = true, onExpandedChange: ((Boolean) -> Unit)? = null, emptyMessage: String? = null, errorMessage: String? = null, onRetry: (() -> Unit)? = null, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, toggleIcon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, footer: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, labels: MonarchSectionCardLabels = MonarchSectionCardLabels(), content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)
public enum class MonarchSectionCardState { Ready, Loading, Empty, Error }
public class MonarchSectionCardLabels(loading: String? = null, emptyTitle: String? = null, errorTitle: String? = null, expanded: String? = null, collapsed: String? = null, tone: String? = null)

options.name: title
options.description: The section title. A TalkBack heading.

options.name: modifier
options.description: The modifier of the card.

options.name: description
options.description: A sentence under the title.

options.name: meta
options.description: A short secondary line: a count, a date range.

options.name: tone
options.description: Danger for a destructive zone: the border and the icon in the tone, and the tone's name spoken with the title. Other tones work the same way.

options.name: state
options.description: What the body shows: the content, three skeleton rows, the empty state or the error state.

options.name: busy
options.description: Refreshing in place: a progress ring after the title while the content stays.

options.name: retrying
options.description: The error state's retry is running.

options.name: flush
options.description: No body padding, for a list or a table that runs to the edges.

options.name: expanded
options.description: Whether the body and footer show. Only used with onExpandedChange.

options.name: onExpandedChange
options.description: Makes the header a button that shows and hides the body and footer. Without it the card is not collapsible.

options.name: emptyMessage
options.description: The message of the empty state.

options.name: errorMessage
options.description: The message of the error state.

options.name: onRetry
options.description: Shows a retry button in the error state.

options.name: icon
options.description: A decorative icon before the title, tinted in the tone.

options.name: toggleIcon
options.description: A chevron at the end of a collapsible header; it turns half a turn while expanded. No default: Monarch bundles no icons.

options.name: actions
options.description: Buttons, a menu or a View all link at the end of the header. They move under the title when they need more than half the width.

options.name: footer
options.description: The footer bar under a line.

options.name: labels
options.description: Replacements for Loading, the empty and error titles, Expanded, Collapsed and the tone's name.

options.name: content
options.description: The body, shown in the ready state.

states.name: loading
states.description: Three skeleton rows from MonarchLoadingState, which announces Loading; the title reads Loading as its state.

states.name: empty
states.description: A small MonarchEmptyState with Nothing here yet and the empty message.

states.name: error
states.description: A small MonarchErrorState with This section didn’t load, the error message and a retry button when onRetry is set.

states.name: busy
states.description: A progress ring after the title (a still ring when animations are off); the content stays; the title reads Loading as its state.

states.name: collapsed
states.description: Only the header; the toggle icon is not turned. The title reads Collapsed, or Expanded when open.

states.name: tone
states.description: A tone other than neutral colors the border and the icon and adds the tone's name to the title's state.

appearance: The MonarchCard surface: the surface fill, a 1dp border in the default border color (the tone's border color for a toned card) and large corners. The header uses the MonarchSectionHeader type and colors; the footer sits under a line in the subtle border color. Every color comes from the theme roles, so light, dark and both high-contrast themes follow the theme.
platformNotes: The parity map names MonarchCard with header and footer slots. MonarchCard pads its content evenly, has no footer and a fixed border color, so the section card draws the same Material Surface with the MonarchCard fill, shape and border width to support flush bodies, a footer and a toned border, as iOS does. The web takes a custom empty node; on Android keep the state Ready and put a MonarchEmptyState with actions in the content, as on iOS. The web's link slot is the actions slot, and headingLevel has no Compose equivalent (the title is a heading). The web's uncontrolled open state is not offered: expanded and onExpandedChange are hoisted, as in MonarchCollapsible; iOS keeps its own state. MonarchSectionHeader draws the title in the default text color, so the tone colors the border and the icon but not the title; the tone's name is spoken. Monarch bundles no icons, so the chevron of a collapsible card is the toggleIcon slot. The danger tone is spoken as "Danger", not the shared "Error", on purpose: the web tone marks a destructive zone ("Danger zone" settings such as delete or transfer), not a failure, so "Error" would tell a TalkBack user that something went wrong. The key monarch_sectioncard_tone_danger is not deprecated.
accessibility: The header is one TalkBack element: the title as a heading, with the description and meta; the actions stay separate elements.
A collapsible header is a button with a 48dp touch target, the state Expanded or Collapsed, and the TalkBack expand and collapse actions.
While loading or busy the title's state adds Loading, and the loading state announces Loading through a polite live region.
A tone other than neutral adds the tone's name to the title's state, so the tone is not color alone.
The title wraps whole at font scale 2.0, and the actions follow the title in the reading order in both directions.
edgeCases: A collapsed card removes the body and the footer from the composition; hoist any state inside them that must survive.
expanded is ignored without onExpandedChange: the body always shows.
The error state shows no retry button without onRetry.
Several state parts are spoken in order, separated by commas: Expanded, Danger, Loading.
